# AngularGaugeChart ## Overview A complete angular gauge chart visualization that composes ChartHeader, ChartLegend, a standalone DataDisplay, AngularGaugeGroup (diverging arc + needle), and ChartFooter into a cohesive chart layout. All design tokens resolve from the live CSS cascade — no runtime JS token resolver, no `modes` prop. DataVis palette tokens (`--DataVis-DivergingSemantic-N`, `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`) are supplied by `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection`; surface/typography tokens by the brand CSS engine. **Features:** - Full chart layout: title, subtitle, legend, standalone DataDisplay, gauge arc, and source/notes - D3-powered semicircular arc with 11 diverging semantic color segments (step mode) or smooth gradient (blend mode) - Standalone DataDisplay for summary values above the gauge; separate center DataDisplay inside the gauge - `data[0].value` drives the gauge needle; additional points auto-generate tick values and legend items - `fullWidth` prop stretches the container to 100% of its parent - ARIA live region announces hovered segments to screen readers - Full keyboard navigation via `useRovingTabIndex` inside `AngularGaugeGroup` ## Figma Reference - **Node ID**: `767:4884` - **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=767-4884 ## Architecture ``` AngularGaugeChart ├── ChartAccessibility (wrapper — role="figure", live region, hidden data table) │ ├── ChartHeader (title + subtitle) │ ├── ChartLegend (categorical legend, up to 6 items) │ ├── DataDisplay (standalone, above the gauge) │ ├── AngularGaugeGroup (gauge arcs · needle · ticks · center DataDisplay) │ └── ChartFooter (source + notes) ``` Token supply: ``` Convex (dataVisPalettes) → generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection → --DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n} (legend colors) → --DataVis-DivergingSemantic-{n} (arc segment fills, inside AngularGaugeGroup) Brand CSS engine (useBrandCSSNew) → --Spacing-5 (container gap via two-layer pattern) → --Label-*, --Body-*, --Text-* (typography) ``` ## Import ```tsx import { AngularGaugeChart } from '@oneui/datavis'; // or from the package barrel: import { AngularGaugeChart } from '@oneui/datavis/AngularGaugeChart'; ``` ## Data Format `data` accepts `ChartDataPoint[]`: ```typescript interface ChartDataPoint { category: string; // Label for the data point value: number; // The value (data[0].value → gauge needle) color?: string; // Optional color override for legend item colorIndex?: number; } const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [{ category: 'Score', value: 0.72 }]; ``` The **first** data point's `value` drives the gauge needle, overriding `gaugeGroupConfig.value`. Additional points auto-generate tick positions (`tickValues`) and legend items when no explicit config is provided. ## Props ### Parent Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | ------------------- | --------------------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `data` | `ChartDataPoint[]` | `[]` | Chart data — `data[0].value` drives the gauge needle | | `width` | `number \| string` | `420` | Width of the chart container | | `height` | `number \| string` | `"auto"` | Height of the chart container | | `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch container to 100% of parent width; overrides `width` | | `chartHeader` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the chart header (title + subtitle) | | `chartFooter` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the chart footer (source + notes) | | `chartLegend` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the categorical legend | | `dataDisplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the standalone DataDisplay above the gauge | | `animated` | `boolean` | `false` | Entry animation on mount via motion tokens | | `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig` | — | Screen reader configuration | ### Child Config Props | Prop | Type | Description | | ------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | | `chartHeaderConfig` | `ChartHeaderConfig` | `{ chartTitleValue, chartSubtitleValue, subtitle }` | | `chartLegendConfig` | `ChartLegendConfig` | `{ items, categoryLabelValue, type }` | | `dataDisplayConfig` | `AngularGaugeChartDataDisplayConfig` | Full `DataDisplay` API minus `id` | | `gaugeGroupConfig` | `GaugeGroupConfig` | `AngularGaugeGroup` configuration (see below) | | `chartFooterConfig` | `ChartFooterConfig` | `{ annotationLeftValue, annotationRightValue }` | ### GaugeGroupConfig | Property | Type | Default | Description | | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | | `value` | `number` | `0.5` | Fallback needle value (overridden by `data[0].value`) | | `min` | `number` | `0` | Minimum scale value | | `max` | `number` | `1` | Maximum scale value | | `numberOfSteps` | `number` | `5` | Steps per side of neutral (1–5). Total segments = 2n + 1 | | `tickValues` | `(string \| number)[]` | 3 evenly spaced | Explicit arc tick label positions | | `showGaugeTicks` | `boolean` | `true` | Show tick labels along the arc | | `showEndpointTicks` | `boolean` | `true` | Show non-rotating endpoint ticks at min/max | | `endpointTickValues` | `[string \| number, string \| number]` | auto | Custom labels for min/max endpoint ticks | | `showDataDisplay` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the center DataDisplay inside the gauge | | `showSupportingLabelsTop` | `boolean` | `false` | Show top supporting label row | | `showSupportingLabelsBottom` | `boolean` | `false` | Show bottom supporting label row | | `arcWidth` | `"auto" \| "XS" \| "S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL" \| "2XL"` | `"auto"` | Arc thickness | | `type` | `"step" \| "blend"` | `"step"` | Discrete segments or smooth gradient arc | | `valueFormat` | `ValueFormatConfig` | — | Auto-format numeric tick labels | | `interactive` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable hover/focus/keyboard interactivity on segments | | `onSegmentHover` | `(data: GaugeSegmentHoverData) => void` | — | Callback on segment hover/focus change | | `dataDisplayConfig` | `GaugeDataDisplayConfig` | — | Center DataDisplay inside the gauge | | `supportingLabelsTop` | `SupportingLabelsConfig` | — | Top supporting label row config | | `supportingLabelsBottom` | `SupportingLabelsConfig` | — | Bottom supporting label row config | ### AccessibilityConfig | Property | Type | Default | Description | | ----------- | --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------- | | `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable the accessibility wrapper | | `summary` | `string` | auto | Custom summary (overrides auto-generate) | | `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true` | Hidden data table for screen readers | | `ariaLabel` | `string` | — | Custom aria-label override | ## Usage Examples ### Minimal gauge ```tsx import { AngularGaugeChart } from '@oneui/datavis'; var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{i+1})` ## Tick Value Resolution Tick positions resolve in priority order: 1. **Explicit** — `gaugeGroupConfig.tickValues` 2. **Data-driven** — `data[1..N].value` (when `data.length > 1` and no explicit `tickValues`) 3. **Default** — `AngularGaugeGroup` renders 3 evenly spaced ticks at 25%, 50%, 75% of the range Endpoint ticks at min/max resolve separately: 1. **Explicit** — `gaugeGroupConfig.endpointTickValues` 2. **Auto-derived** — formatted from `min`/`max` using `valueFormat` (or raw numeric display) ## Accessibility - `ChartAccessibility` wraps all content in `role="figure"` with a generated or custom `aria-label` - `ChartAccessibility` renders a visually-hidden `` for screen reader data access - The ARIA live region (via `useChartAccessibility`) announces hovered segments: `"Negative 3 zone, segment 3 of 11"` - Arc segments use `useRovingTabIndex`: **Tab** enters the group; **ArrowLeft/ArrowRight** moves between segments; **Home/End** jumps to first/last ## Files | File | Description | | --------------------------------- | ----------------------------- | | `AngularGaugeChart.tsx` | Component implementation | | `AngularGaugeChart.module.css` | Structural CSS (container gap) | | `index.ts` | Named exports | | `AngularGaugeChart.stories.tsx` | Storybook documentation | | `AngularGaugeChart.test.tsx` | Unit tests | | `AngularGaugeChart.md` | This documentation | ## Related - [`AngularGaugeGroup`](../../groups/AngularGaugeGroup/AngularGaugeGroup.md) — the core gauge arc component - [`ChartHeader`](../../groups/ChartHeader/ChartHeader.md) - [`ChartLegend`](../../groups/ChartLegend/ChartLegend.md) - [`DataDisplay`](../../groups/DataDisplay/DataDisplay.md) - [`ChartFooter`](../../groups/ChartFooter/ChartFooter.md) - [`ChartAccessibility`](../../ChartAccessibility.tsx)
